parsed.name: Binder MK 56 气候试验箱
parsed.description: 这是一台实验室气候试验箱，用于在受控箱体环境中对样品进行温度相关的稳定性测试、环境模拟和常规培养/存放实验。设备通过箱门装载样品，并可查看运行模式与箱门状态。
parsed.description_en: This is a laboratory climate chamber used to expose samples to a controlled chamber environment for temperature-related stability testing, environmental simulation, and routine incubation or storage experiments. Samples are loaded through the chamber door, and the device provides operating-mode and door-status information.

actions.description_en: Get whether the chamber door is open
